caption: The drawing features a pouch-like object divided vertically into two halves; the left half is predominantly red, while the right half is cream-colored. Both halves are adorned with a pattern of small, evenly spaced blue-gray marks and intricate stitching along the edges, with each half bearing a large, yellow, paisley-like motif outlined in red. The two halves are joined together down the middle, with a decorative cord, featuring twists of red and cream, threaded horizontally through loops near the top edges and tied with a knot at the center. Two fluffy red pom-poms are attached to twisted cords that emerge from the top, looping upward and then resting down. Additional decoration includes a long, multicolored tassel—mostly pinkish with some white and yellow—hanging from the center bottom of the pouch, and small oval-shaped, red-and-white drop-like beads attached to the bottom corners and the junction of the pouch. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Bag
